clues: The critical developmental window spanning weeks 4 through 8 after fertilization.
During this period, the three germ layers differentiate into all major tissues and organ primordia.
Embryos are maximally susceptible to major structural birth defects from teratogens during this time.
Paired, segmentally arranged blocks of paraxial mesoderm flanking the neural tube and notochord.
They appear in a craniocaudal sequence starting around day 20 and are used to estimate embryonic age.
Each block differentiates into a sclerotome, myotome, and dermatome.
The ventromedial portion of each somite that undergoes epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition.
Its mesenchymal cells migrate around the notochord and neural tube.
Through resegmentation, it forms the vertebral bodies, neural arches, and ribs.
A narrow endoderm-lined channel pinched off during lateral embryonic folding in week 4.
It connects the midgut loop to the umbilical vesicle (yolk sac) within the umbilical cord.
Failure of its proximal intra-abdominal portion to obliterate results in Meckel diverticulum.
A congenital ventral abdominal wall defect typically located just to the right of a normally inserted umbilical cord.
It results from incomplete lateral body wall folding during week 4.
Unlike omphalocele, the herniated bowel loops lack a covering peritoneal or amniotic sac.
A specialized thickened strip of epithelium along the distal margin of each emerging limb bud.
It secretes fibroblast growth factors (FGF4 and FGF8) to keep underlying mesenchymal cells proliferating.
It controls proximodistal outgrowth of the limb from stylopod to autopod.
A small cluster of mesenchymal cells located at the posterior base of a developing limb bud.
It secretes a morphogen gradient of Sonic hedgehog (SHH) protein.
It specifies the anteroposterior axis of the hand and foot from thumb to little finger.
A standard biometric linear measurement obtained during first-trimester obstetric ultrasound.
It measures the distance from the top of the embryonic head to the midpoint of the buttocks.
It provides the most accurate estimate of gestational age between weeks 7 and 14.
